description:
Complete quantum experiment configuration.

This model defines all parameters needed to run a quantum experiment,
from basic circuit parameters to advanced research configurations.

num_qubits.description: Number of qubits in the quantum circuit
num_qubits.title: Num Qubits

state_type.description: Type of quantum state to prepare
state_type.title: State Type

sim_mode.description: Simulation mode: 'qasm' for shot-based, 'density' for density matrix
sim_mode.title: Sim Mode

shots.description: Number of measurement shots for qasm simulation
shots.title: Shots

noise_enabled.description: Whether to apply noise to the quantum circuit
noise_enabled.title: Noise Enabled

noise_type.description: Type of noise model to apply
noise_type.title: Noise Type

error_rate.description: Error rate for noise models (0.0 = no noise, 1.0 = maximum noise)
error_rate.title: Error Rate

enable_research_metrics.description: Enable computation of structured decoherence pathway metrics (AI, PCR, EEC, TPS, CES)
enable_research_metrics.title: Enable Research Metrics

research_type.description: Type of research analysis to perform
research_type.title: Research Type

multiple_runs.description: Number of experimental runs for statistical validation
multiple_runs.title: Multiple Runs

track_convergence.description: Enable convergence tracking for high-precision experiments
track_convergence.title: Track Convergence

rng_seed.description: Random number generator seed for reproducible results
rng_seed.title: Rng Seed

custom_params.description: Custom parameters for advanced state preparation or noise models
custom_params.title: Custom Params

title: ExperimentConfig
